title: TRICARE Select Tier Entry Gates and Enrollment Terms
content:
**TRICARE Select** is held per beneficiary in six tiers. Each tier admits only the DEERS beneficiary categories, sponsor entry group and sponsor pay-grade band listed below, and sets the enrollment window and effective dates that apply to it.

## Entry gate and enrollment terms by tier

The first four columns are the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers (for example, "Group A (E-1 to E-4)" is TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)); the last two are TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

| | Group A (E-1 to E-4) | Group A (E-5 and Above) | Group B (E-1 to E-4) | Group B (E-5 and Above) | Retiree Group A | Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DEERS beneficiary categories admitted | active duty family member; transitional survivor | active duty family member; transitional survivor | active duty family member; transitional survivor | active duty family member; transitional survivor | retired service member; retiree family member; survivor | retired service member; retiree family member; survivor |
| Sponsor entry group | Group A | Group A | Group B | Group B | Group A | Group B |
| Sponsor pay-grade band | E-1 to E-4 | E-5 and above | E-1 to E-4 | E-5 and above | any | any |
| Qualifying-life-event enrollment window (calendar days after the DEERS event) | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Open-season election allowed | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Effective date of a qualifying-life-event enrollment | date of the qualifying life event | date of the qualifying life event | date of the qualifying life event | date of the qualifying life event | date of the qualifying life event | date of the qualifying life event |
| Effective date of an open-season election | January 1 of the following plan year | January 1 of the following plan year | January 1 of the following plan year | January 1 of the following plan year | January 1 of the following plan year | January 1 of the following plan year |
| Transfer to another region's contractor on a move | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed | allowed |

## Terms used in the table

- **Group A** is a sponsor who first entered uniformed service before 2018-01-01; **Group B** is a sponsor who first entered on or after 2018-01-01.
- **E-1 to E-4** covers sponsor pay grades E-1 through E-4; **E-5 and above** covers every other grade, warrant officers and commissioned officers included. The retiree tiers serve any pay grade.
- The TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and Retiree Group B entry gates also require that the beneficiary is not entitled to Medicare Part A.

## Reading the table (illustrations drawn from the rows above)

- A retiree family member whose sponsor first entered service on a hypothetical 2016-07-15 falls in the Group A column of the retiree tiers: TRICARE Select Retiree Group A.
- An active duty family member whose sponsor holds E-6 and first entered service on a hypothetical 2019-02-01 falls in TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above).
- In every tier a qualifying-life-event enrollment takes effect on the date of the event, and an open-season election takes effect on January 1 of the following plan year.
